say:2:1041573601:1.source_cn: 加热的饮品？真是惹人心烦。

say:3:1041573602:1.text: Why are you curled up like a little chick caught in a blizzard?
say:3:1041573602:1.source_cn: 呵，你怎么是一副蜷缩的模样，像只被暴雪困住的雏鸟。

say:4:1041573603:1.text: M-Miss... I can't feel my tongue... I think it's about to fall off...
say:4:1041573603:1.source_cn: 这、这位……女士，我的舌头，快要砸到脚上了……

say:5:1041573604:1.text: This blasted weather... That's... that's enough talk...
say:5:1041573604:1.source_cn: 鬼天气……呼……差不多，该……该结束谈话了……

say:7:1041573606:1.text: Does this perfectly pleasant chill really bother you?
say:7:1041573606:1.source_cn: 这恰到好处的清凉，难道会让你感到不适吗，亲爱的？

say:8:1041573607:1.text: Look, your white breath is dancing in my palm. It's just the beginning!
say:8:1041573607:1.source_cn: 你看，连你呼出的白雾都在我的掌心跳舞，我们的游戏才刚刚...

say:9:1041573608:1.text: Hah... I see... We'll talk... only after I transform...
say:9:1041573608:1.source_cn: 呼……既然这样……变……变形之后……我们慢慢聊……

say:12:1041573609:1.text: It's a lot warmer now. Feels like I just plunged straight into a hot spring—my frozen-numb limbs finally loosen up.
say:12:1041573609:1.source_cn: 现在暖和多了，感觉像是把冻僵的思路一下子扔进了温泉里，...

say:13:1041573610:1.text: Alright, Lady Winter. Now, what were we saying?
say:13:1041573610:1.source_cn: 好了，冰霜女士，你刚才想说冰风还是什么来着？

say:14:1041573611:1.text: Oh? Not only has your appearance changed, but also the essence of your life has been rewritten. What an exquisite spell.
say:14:1041573611:1.source_cn: 哦？不仅仅是外表的改变，连生命的本质气息都彻底转换了。...

say:15:1041573612:1.text: If I could master a craft like that... freeze those lovely bodies solid, then take their shapes.
say:15:1041573612:1.source_cn: 若我能掌握这般技艺，冻僵那些美妙的躯体，再变形为他们的模样。

say:16:1041573613:1.text: Heh. I could take their place for good. And when one shell stops amusing me, I simply take the next. Tell me that isn't more fun.
say:16:1041573613:1.source_cn: 呵，这样一来，便能永久地取代他们，要是倦了，便换下一具...

say:17:1041573614:1.text: You've got it wrong. Transfiguration is all about communication and harmony. It is not a tool for you to erase someone's life.
say:17:1041573614:1.source_cn: 我想你误入了歧途，变形术的关键在于理解与和谐，而不是粗...

say:18:1041573615:1.text: The control you crave is nothing but cruel shackles you'd clamp on the world.
say:18:1041573615:1.source_cn: 你迷恋的掌控，不过是给世界套上残忍的镣铐。

say:19:1041573616:1.text: Shackles? Laughable! When everything is sealed in ice, it shows its purest nature.
say:19:1041573616:1.source_cn: 镣铐？呵，冰晶凝结时，万物才会呈现出更纯粹的本质。

say:20:1041573617:1.text: Like the flame dancing in your pupils. Isn't it only so bright because of the cold around it?
say:20:1041573617:1.source_cn: 就像此刻，你瞳孔里跳动的火焰，不正因为周围的寒意才显得...

say:21:1041573618:1.text: Freeze a frog into ice and all you get is a pathetic sight. Calling that a revelation of nature is you lying to yourself.
say:21:1041573618:1.source_cn: 照你这么说，把青蛙冻在冰里也能算揭示本质？那不过是定格...

say:22:1041573619:1.text: Trees need good soil, the right warmth, and sunlight to grow. People are no different. They don't exist to be pinned in your display case like specimens.
say:22:1041573619:1.source_cn: 真正的本质像树根，需要温暖的土壤才能向上生长，而不是被...

say:23:1041573620:1.text: Heh. Tasteless beast. Spare me the chatter.
say:23:1041573620:1.source_cn: 呵，愚笨的动物，罢了，多费口舌。
